complete_source_declarations.name: affineSandwich_test_error
complete_source_declarations.complete_signature:
private theorem affineSandwich_test_error {d r : ℕ}
    (L : Fin r → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℝ)
    (R : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hlo : primeAffineGateRegion L c ⊆ R)
    (hhi : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ j, L j x ≤ c j) (m : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |R.indicator f x - f x * affinePrimeGateRamp L c false m x| ≤
      |f x| * (affinePrimeGateRamp L c true m x - affinePrimeGateRamp L c false m x)
complete_source_declarations.independent_assessment: Pointwise bound for any signed f on any R between strict and weak gates. Inside R use upper=1 and lower<=1; outside R strict-subset implies lower=0. No wall atom is removed.

complete_source_declarations.name: integral_affineSandwich
complete_source_declarations.complete_signature:
private theorem integral_affineSandwich {d r : ℕ} (a b : ℝ)
    (L : Fin r → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (hL : ∀ j, L j ≠ 0)
    (R : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hR : MeasurableSet R)
    (hlo : primeAffineGateRegion L c ⊆ R) (hhi : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ j, L j x ≤ c j)
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) :
    (∫ x in logPrimeBox (fun _ : Fin d => a) (fun _ => b) ∩ primeAffineGateRegion L c,
      f x * ∏ i, 1 / x i) =
    ∫ x in logPrimeBox (fun _ : Fin d => a) (fun _ => b) ∩ R,
      f x * ∏ i, 1 / x i
complete_source_declarations.independent_assessment: Nonzero finite forms give Lebesgue-null walls. Only here strict gate and R are identified almost everywhere; setIntegral_indicator and integral_congr_ae need no supplied arithmetic premise.

complete_source_declarations.complete_signature:
theorem tendsto_actualPrimeBoxTestSum_cube_affineSandwich {d r : ℕ} {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (L : Fin r → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (hL : ∀ j, L j ≠ 0)
    (R : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hR : MeasurableSet R)
    (hlo : primeAffineGateRegion L c ⊆ R) (hhi : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ j, L j x ≤ c j)
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.univ.pi (fun _ : Fin d => Set.Icc a b))) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => actualPrimeBoxTestSum N (fun _ : Fin d => a) (fun _ => b)
      (R.indicator f)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x in logPrimeBox (fun _ : Fin d => a) (fun _ => b) ∩ R,
        f x * ∏ i, 1 / x i))
complete_source_declarations.independent_assessment: Choose ramp index m using two proved continuous-integral limits before N. Two actual continuous prime-test limits and nonnegative actual reciprocal-prime weights pay four epsilon/4 errors. Caller supplies only positive fixed cube, nonzero forms, measurable intermediate R and continuous signed f.

complete_source_declarations.complete_definition:
def primeIcoBoxGateForms {d r : ℕ}
    (L : Fin r → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Fin (d + (d + r)) → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  Fin.append (fun i => -ContinuousLinearMap.proj i)
    (Fin.append (fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.proj i) L)
complete_source_declarations.independent_assessment: Exact Fin.append of d negative coordinate projections, d positive projections, then r caller forms.

complete_source_declarations.name: mem_primeIcoBoxStrictGateRegion
complete_source_declarations.complete_signature:
theorem mem_primeIcoBoxStrictGateRegion {d r : ℕ}
    (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (L : Fin r → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    x ∈ primeAffineGateRegion (primeIcoBoxGateForms L) (primeIcoBoxGateBounds lo hi c) ↔
      (∀ i, lo i < x i ∧ x i < hi i) ∧ x ∈ primeAffineGateRegion L c
complete_source_declarations.independent_assessment: Strict gate exactly lo_i<x_i<hi_i for all i plus caller strict gates.

complete_source_declarations.name: primeIcoBox_weak_gates
complete_source_declarations.complete_signature:
private theorem primeIcoBox_weak_gates {d r : ℕ}
    (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (L : Fin r → (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℝ)
    {x : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ logPrimeBox lo hi ∩ primeAffineGateRegion L c) :
    ∀ j, primeIcoBoxGateForms L j x ≤ primeIcoBoxGateBounds lo hi c j
complete_source_declarations.independent_assessment: Actual Ico lower weak and upper strict coordinates imply all weak coordinate rows; original strict caller gates imply their weak rows.

    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)

    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => actualPrimeBoxTestSum N (fun _ : Fin d => a) (fun _ => b)

        f x * ∏ i, 1 / x i))
